answer: The bonus interest rate on the Skyline Saver account is 4.25% p.a. However, to receive the full bonus rate, the customer must meet certain conditions, including depositing at least $200 from an external source, making no more than 3 withdrawals, and keeping the closing balance higher than the opening balance. If any of these conditions are not met, the base rate of 0.5% p.a. applies for that month only.
The annual fee on the Skyline Rewards credit card is $129, waived in year 1 for new customers.

The bonus interest rate on the Horizon Saver account is 5.10% p.a., but it is subject to certain conditions. To receive the full bonus rate, the customer must deposit at least $1,000 from an external source and make no more than 1 withdrawal in the same calendar month. If either condition is not met, the base rate of 0.10% p.a. applies for that month.
